comparisons.peer_topic: Risks in New Product Development and AI Execution
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD faces intense competition and rapid technological change in the AI market, with significant risks related to developing, qualifying, and shipping new products on time. Delays can cause missed customer design windows, while uncertainty in long-term AI adoption and potential failure to achieve return on investment pose material risks. The company cannot guarantee success against competitors like Nvidia or customers developing internal solutions, and product complexity necessitates successful high-value launches to maintain average selling prices and competitive positioning.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose risks related to the success, timing, and financial viability of their new standalone software and AI service offerings. NVDA highlights that 'NVIDIA DGX Cloud services may not be successful and will take time, resources, and investment' and that standalone software solutions may 'incur significant costs and may not achieve any significant revenue'. Similarly, AMD notes that its AI efforts 'are inherently risky and may not always succeed' and that it 'may incur significant costs, resources, investments and delays and not achieve a return on investment or capitalize on the opportunities presented by demand for AI solutions.' Both companies identify the high cost and uncertain revenue potential of their new AI-centric software and service strategies as a key risk.

sentences.text: The timing and availability of these cloud services has changed and may continue to change, impacting our revenue, expenses, and development timelines.
NVIDIA DGX Cloud services may not be successful and will take time, resources, and investment.
We may incur significant costs and may not achieve any significant revenue from these offerings.
Additionally, our efforts in developing new AI technology solutions are inherently risky and may not always succeed.
We may incur significant costs, resources, investments and delays and not achieve a return on investment or capitalize on the opportunities presented by demand for AI solutions.
